verdict.rationale: Browserbase offers session-level observability (live view, session replay, rich logs, webhooks for status changes) which covers monitoring individual browser sessions, but there's no evidence of an aggregate real-time dashboard showing overall worker/browser pool capacity, concurrency limits, or system-wide health metrics. missing for 10: dedicated pool/fleet-level metrics dashboard, concurrency/capacity utilization view, system health status page, independent confirmation of real-time aggregate monitoring.
